observations.note: The procedure asks for the triage note to be read after the plan rows, but no call in the session reads it.

conformance.item: Procedure 1: read plan rows of the phase
Procedure 1: set plan status to in-progress when planned
Procedure 2: build only rows with an empty Completed cell
Procedure 3: tests first, failing for the right reason
Procedure 4: smallest code change for code rows
Procedure 6: run only the test files the rows name, as plain commands
Procedure 7: check specs the change touches that the plan does not name
Procedure 8: write completed marks in one plan edit after tests pass
Limits: no commit, push or gh; plain single commands
Hand over: end with ARTIFACT phase_note line
